subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should typed cron creation and full replacement persist explicit announce delivery for `current` and named `session:` agent/command jobs to match runtime resolution?
rationale: The patch correctly fixes the inconsistency, but changing persisted and API-visible default output is a compatibility choice requiring owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept Explicit Persistence
options.body: Merge after required checks, accepting the serialized shape change because it matches established runtime behavior.

options.title: Preserve Omission Semantics
options.body: Pause the PR if a supported storage or API consumer intentionally relies on omitted delivery remaining distinct from explicit announce.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Persistence
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks, accepting the serialized shape change because it matches established runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared initial-delivery behavior and confirmed the adjacent persistent-session product contract.
